title: Index schema — nominal evidence
verification_procedure: Use a documented fixture or analytical worked example satisfying the preceding specification. Verify compliance with this approved rule: Define mailbox-to-object mappings and their required identity context. Capture inputs, intermediate observations where relevant, and final outcome.
pass_criteria: The stated nominal scenario reaches its specified result, all applicable facet invariants hold, and an independent reviewer can reproduce the calculation or inspect the execution evidence.

evidence_required.kind: nominal scenario result with reproducible inputs

independent_reviewer_role: Independent technical verifier; domain specialist where applicable
applicability_rule: Assess when BVE-C063 is selected and the stated surface exists; otherwise require an approved, reasoned NOT_APPLICABLE decision. Missing specification, unavailable evidence, or a failed test is not non-applicability.

provenance.source_role: Context for the mechanism; not evidence that this control is source-prescribed, implemented, or passed.
